sam: Heads-up: trying to bring up llama5 via the new bridge-x converter into ptq-int4. Quick smoke shows a small but consistent regression on summarization tasks. Repro steps below.

sam: Repro (local):
```
python convert/bridge_x.py --model llama5 --out ./llama5-bx/ --quant ptq-int4 --group 128
./eval/harness --model ./llama5-bx/ --task news-sum --seed 21 --batch 8
```

jia: Numbers? how bad is it?

sam: Rouge-L down ~4.5, brief factual hallucinations ~9% (was ~2%), ppl +0.5. Inference stable.

jia: My quick dump shows tiny per-head inv_freq deviation in a few heads (layer 5 heads 2 & 6 ~1.00065 vs fp32). That feels like a rotary-scale mismatch.

oliver: Run a light logit-ddiff (first 80 tokens) and a per-head L2 breakdown; that separates rotary vs projection reorder.

sam: Running: `./tools/logit_ddiff --ref ./models/llama5-fp32 --alt ./llama5-bx/ --len 80 --out /tmp/bx-dd.json`

ci-bot: Job queued: 1709991111-ci-rotary-audit.

ci-bot: Job finished. Summary: divergence onset token ~10; top-5 mismatch rate rises 2%->15% by token 30. Heads with largest L2: layer5 heads 2,6 and layer8 head 0. Measured inv_freq ratios ~1.0006-1.0007 on those.

natalie: Small, consistent multipliers like that can amplify during autoregressive decoding. Quick experiment: apply inv_freq * 0.99935 to the problematic heads in the converted weights and re-run the smoke eval.

jia: Applied a hotfix shim to the converted weights (inv_freq *= 0.99935 on affected heads) and re-ran the harness: Rouge-L gap reduced to ~1.0, hallucination rate dropped to ~3.6%. Logit-ddiff now much closer to fp32.

oliver: Good signal. Also try group-size ablations (64,128) and per-tensor vs per-channel quant to rule out quant granularity.

sam: Did quick ablation: group=64 per-channel helped marginally (~0.3 pts) but nowhere near the rotary shim impact.

natalie: Action items: 1) add a per-head rotary-scale sanity check in bridge-x converter that computes inv_freq ratios vs a catalog baseline or fp32 reference and warns if any head deviates >5e-4, 2) add an optional `--auto-fix-rotary` to apply small corrective multipliers when detected, 3) add a 10-sample news-sum smoke test in CI for new converts. I'll create a ticket.

sam: I'll PR the converter check + auto-fix flag and wire the smoke eval into CI. ETA tomorrow EOD.

jia: Filed MLD-3899: "bridge-x: llama5 int4 onboarding - tiny per-head rotary inv_freq drift causing quality regression" and attached ddiff + eval artifacts.

oliver: For long-term: consider persisting per-model rotary metadata in model catalog rather than heuristics; also add a head-order parity test to catch silent reorder issues.

natalie: Agreed. If the fix shows regressions on other models, we'll add a catalog entry per model. Ping #eng-ml if you need ops for dedicated runs. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Closing job 1709991111-ci-rotary-audit (artifacts: /ci/artifacts/1709991111/).
